rows.measurement_window: earliest request arrival through simulation end, including initialization wait

measurement_windows.semantics: primary rates span earliest request arrival through simulation end; TTFT/E2E start at each request arrival; runtime rates exclude initialization

prefill.semantics: wall rate uses completed requests' input tokens once for prefill and committed non-prefill output tokens for decode; both use the primary request window. Busy rate includes scheduled/recomputed work; mixed batches overlap and busy rates are not additive

decode.semantics: wall rate uses completed requests' input tokens once for prefill and committed non-prefill output tokens for decode; both use the primary request window. Busy rate includes scheduled/recomputed work; mixed batches overlap and busy rates are not additive

memory_metrics.scope: operator NAND traffic (HBF/SSD); separately reported KV migration traffic is not implicitly included

active_service_lane_imbalance.semantics: busy-time imbalance among observed effective service lanes; not a physical-plane measurement and not all configured idle lanes

unavailable.physical_plane_imbalance: effective-lane mapping is not a calibrated plane geometry
unavailable.read_queue_depth: page-level queue occupancy timeline not recorded
unavailable.program_queue_depth: page-level queue occupancy timeline not recorded

memory_metrics.semantics: GB/s equals bytes/ns; logical/media ratios include RMW and merging and must not be called physical page fill fractions

rows.quantile_scope: empirical interpolation over reported sample count; no population tail-latency guarantee

modeling_limits: offload_ratio bounds pressure-triggered migratable capacity; it is not a per-token mirror ratio
prefetch disabled when prefetch_distance=0
logical KV traffic counters are not added to resource-accounted bytes when attention kernels already include local memory traffic
KV read means external persisted-cache access only; prefill/recompute historical-prompt attention remains modeled as causal compute and ordinary attention/activation traffic

dram_traffic.accounting_semantics: resolved analytical burst bytes and controller waits; null means not fully recorded; empty organization_profiles is not evidence of complete geometry reporting; no device accuracy claim

supported: 完整GPU/算子/服务调度时间线

limitations: Hardware is hypothetical: fixed single GPU, 512 GiB HBM and 1 TiB HBF inventory; unused capacity is retained in the common budget.
C uses priority preemption, physical KV swap and resume, not an agent pause/resume API.
Named model architecture presets retain their true layers/weights; GPU compute remains an uncalibrated analytical model.
Contexts beyond each preset native limit are architecture extrapolation stress tests, without model quality claims.
Finite traces and four output tokens on named models do not establish production tail latency or stable service capacity.
